1. 看崩溃弹窗里的「建议操作」，能禁用嫌疑 Mod、提高内存、下载合适 Jav:
1. Check the “Suggested actions” in the crash dialog: disable the suspect mod, raise memory, download a suitable Java, or repair the version files.
2. Tapping Launch runs a preflight check first: low disk space, mods unpacked into folders and an outdated Java are blocked right away.
3. Still failing: send the error report to the developers from the “Feedback” page (sent only after you consent to uploading).
